chunks.title: FAST-Infra Group (FAST-Infra) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: FAST-Infra Group is a Climate Finance Network / Public Facilitator headquartered in France / Switzerland (Global Coalition). At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member scaling labeled sustainable infrastructure. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Deploying the FAST-Infra Sustainable Infrastructure Label & Technology-Enabled Data Platform to turn resilient urban/green infrastructure into a liquid asset class. Source verification: https://www.copbusiness.org/papers/COP31_WG_climate-finance-investments.pdf.

chunks.title: FAST-Infra Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: FAST-Infra Group provides the following climate financing instruments: Sustainable Infrastructure Labeling, Institutional Deal Flow Acceleration, Blended Infrastructure Facility Intro. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 5,000,000 to USD 300,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Municipality, Project SPV, Climate-Tech Startup, Large Corporate, Financial Intermediary.

chunks.title: FAST-Infra Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by FAST-Infra Group: Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Renewable Energy, Water & Wastewater Management, Zero Waste & Circular Economy. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Emerging Markets, Türkiye, Africa, Asia, Latin America. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: FAST-Infra Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete FAST-Infra's application form: Alignment with FAST-Infra 14 sustainability criteria (Environmental, Social, Governance, Resilience); Verifiable digital MRV performance data; Scalable emerging-market infrastructure pipeline. Explicit exclusion rules: Unlabeled fossil-fuel infrastructure. Official application portal: https://www.fastinfragroup.org/.

chunks.title: FAST-Infra Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: FAST-Infra Group uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
